name: Guinea-Bissau
summary: A red vertical band at the hoist with a black star, and yellow over green horizontal bands. Based on the flag of the liberation movement PAIGC, it was adopted when independence was declared in 1973.
origin: The African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (PAIGC), led by Amílcar Cabral, used a similar flag in its war against Portugal. Guinea-Bissau declared independence on 24 September 1973, recognised by Portugal in 1974.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The blood shed during the struggle for independence.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The sun and the wealth of the land; also gold.

symbols.name: Black star
symbols.description: A five-pointed black star in the red band.
symbols.meaning: African unity; the 'Black Star of Africa'.

facts: Ghana's flag also features a black star in the Pan-African colours.
Cape Verde used a similar flag until 1992.
Amílcar Cabral was assassinated in 1973, months before independence was declared.
clues: A red hoist band with a black star, beside yellow over green.
Its design came from a liberation party shared with an island nation.
Independence was declared months after its leader was assassinated.
